name: Nassau Mall
summary: Nassau Mall is a spacious outdoor shopping center in Levittown featuring big-box stores, name-brand retailers, casual dining, and a movie theater. This community-focused destination serves Nassau County residents with convenient one-stop shopping and entertainment options.
demographics: Nassau Mall attracts a diverse middle-class demographic from Levittown and surrounding Nassau County communities, with a strong representation of families and value-conscious shoppers aged 25-54. The trade area serves a predominantly suburban population with median household incomes in the $80,000-$110,000 range, including many dual-income families with children. Shoppers are drawn to the center's mix of big-box retailers and casual dining options for convenient one-stop shopping experiences, with peak traffic during evenings and weekends when families combine errands with entertainment at the movie theater.
description: Nassau Mall is a spacious outdoor shopping destination located on Hempstead Turnpike in Levittown, New York, serving the heart of Nassau County's suburban communities. This open-air retail center has evolved into a popular gathering place for local residents, combining big-box retailers with name-brand stores and casual dining establishments that cater to everyday shopping needs. The mall's convenient layout and ample parking make it an accessible choice for families looking to accomplish multiple errands in one trip. Entertainment options include a movie theater that draws crowds for evening and weekend showings, adding a recreational dimension beyond traditional retail. With operating hours from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM and a strong 4.3-star rating from over 3,000 reviews, Nassau Mall has established itself as a reliable community shopping hub that balances convenience, variety, and value for Long Island shoppers.
